# Revo Treasury

> Revo Treasury is a testnet-only DAO treasury command center for guarded policy compilation, explainable market signals, governance workflows, and Arc Testnet custody.

## Authoritative public resources

- [Revo Treasury](https://therevo.xyz/): Product overview and treasury workflow.
- [Documentation](https://therevo.xyz/docs): Architecture, API, governance, custody, and safety documentation.
- [Risk Disclosure](https://therevo.xyz/risk): Testnet, simulation, AI, custody, and market-data limitations.
- [Privacy Policy](https://therevo.xyz/privacy): Data handling and privacy practices.
- [Terms of Service](https://therevo.xyz/terms): Terms governing use of the Revo testnet application.
